subject: reasoning
question:
Three of the following four letter-clusters are alike In a certain way and one Is different. Pick the odd one out. 

PTXB

GKOS

HKNQ

MQUY
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- Common difference between the position value according to English alphabetic series is (4).

​So,

 
• Option - (1) : PTXB

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea2cac5356b06a9cd8ad6dde1316096a5b4a364d02781e2fac4a98c71d9c30eb.png] 

 
• Option - (2) : MQUY

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a902cb12bc38a3d6238da2940b6cdf252aa15395b0cd922470f47ea1e185bff.png] 

 
• Option - (3) : GKOS

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ce2bed1f0e30527f098127b3d19fd953170981b884b6a84fcba28939ba63a487.png] 

 
• Option - (4) : HKNQ

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fbab2b4c8cc99d0d53f8717f4acbfe9a1d5f04fc1294ce265b682fb594621db6.png] 

Thus, out of all the options 'HKNQ' is the odd one out as the common difference between the position value according to English alphabetic series is (4).

​Hence, "HKNQ" is the correct answer.
